ulasan.Ulasan: ​I have been coming here for both Brazilian and underarm waxes, and the entire experience is consistently top-notch. From the moment you walk in, the reception is warm, welcoming, and impeccably organized. Check-in is a breeze, and you never have to wait around. ​The level of professionalism from the staff instantly puts you at ease. Waxing—especially a Brazilian—can sometimes feel intimidating, but they make the process so quick, comfortable, and smooth that it completely redefines the experience. Everything is handled with the utmost care, hygiene, and efficiency. ​If you want a salon where the team is talented, the environment is pristine, and the whole appointment goes off without a hitch, this is the place to go. I cannot recommend them enough!

ulasan.Ulasan: Wonderful experience with Vivian and the laser treatment on the underarms. Painless and she was kind and efficient. Also, Lexa and Bianca are both very kind and patiently explain the treatments and after care.  I went again for a laser treatment on the underarms with Claudia and a European facial with Lexa. Lexa was super and I really enjoyed the painless and effective facial that left my face looking fresh and rejuvenated. Claudia was also great and kind. She even lowered the intensity if it bothered me. I will definitely return. Thank you. ☺️  I came for a second facial with Marcela and she was amazing as well. She cleaned my face with nicely and did some manual extractions and used the machine to do so, too. She applied two different masks, one of bamboo and the other of cinnamon enzyme. She hydrated my face with a third mask and applied some toner, moisturizer and sunscreen at the end of the session. She even recommended some Doctor D. Schwab products and mentioned I should wash my face morning and night, apply a toner, moisturizer and sunscreen everyday.
